- 09:30: Priya/Marcus free. Elena busy, David busy.
- 10:00: Elena free, David busy.

- ... no other slots from either list. I need to check the entire day.

I will systematically go through every 30-minute slot from Monday to Friday, 9:00 to 17:00, and check the status of all four partners.

First, I need to get the calendars again to be absolutely sure. It's better to work from fresh data.
